packageRules.description: mcp is capped at <2 in pyproject; v2 is a breaking major that needs manual review. Cap renovate to match so it stops proposing v2 (see #362), while 1.x updates still flow.
faiss-cpu and lightspeed-stack-providers are coupled to the runtime environment and require manual validation before upgrading (see #359, #360).
Python version bumps in GitHub Actions and .python-version require coordinated runtime changes, not auto-updates (see #358).
